newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tadiran raised to buy.

text.p: Ofek Securities upgraded Tadiran Ltd to a buy from a hold, saying the Israeli company's shares were trading at about a 20 percent discount to its true value.
An expected improvement in the financial results of its subsidiary Tadiran Telecommunication will help the parent company's results, Ofek said in a report released on Sunday.
Ofek estimated Tadiran's value at 128-142 shekels per share. The shares traded in Tel Aviv closed on Sunday at 115.70, up 3.0 percent.
Ofek said Tadiran's potential would translate into an even higher share price if the company were to issue shares in its subsidiaries.
